exp2.detail: Experiment 2: same design as Experiment 1 with emphasis on social causality (identity-role association counterbalanced across two blocks of animations). Matching task identical (240 trials, 2 blocks). Data: 64 participants x 240 trials (author export 1_Matching_Task_2.csv; Italian column names ruolo/corrispondenza/key_resp_2.rt; RT already in ms - value range 0.33-1082 identical to Exp1, do NOT re-scale from seconds). Participants 14 and 16 excluded only from causality analyses; matching-task data of all 64 participants retained. Paper reports the matching task qualitatively only; SPE direction verified in the database. Shape-identity binding (circle=you vs square=you, counterbalanced) recovered per subject from the author's OrdineP1-40.xlsx files (experiment code, extracted 2026-08-30: 4 circle + 4 square alternating, subjects 1-40) and extrapolated by the same alternation for subjects 41-64 (Ordine files not uploaded; user-approved extrapolation, noted in CSV/Codebook); the raw data column ShapeIdentity keeps the author's identity values. Source: paper full text (PeerJ HTML) + OSF e6hd7; [P] paper, [D] data, [C] code.
